name: Bot Control Menu
author: justneedair
description: HTML menu that sends party-chat commands to Living World phantoms when a button is pressed

name: Bot Summon Menus
author: justneedair
description: Three voiced menus (.lfclass, .lfrole, .lfbuff) that shout LF for one bot at a time.

name: Buff Limits
author: Sateriok
description: Sets 2-hour durations on buffer-NPC buffs and on perma-uptime class self buffs like War Cry. Burst skills such as Frenzy are untouched. Applied in memory at startup; no files edited.

name: Class Master
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a class master NPC that changes a player's profession at levels 20, 40 and 76, with an adena price for each change.

name: GM Shop Full
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran merchant with a menu: weapons, armor and jewelry by grade, raid boss jewels, and consumables with enchant and augment supplies.

name: GM Shop Lite
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran merchant that sells shots, everyday consumables and cosmetic accessories.

name: Preset Buffer
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran NPC that gives a full fighter or mage buff preset in one click.
